summary: A standing approval released a drafted reply without asking a person, and the line names the approval that records the release, the standing approval and the verdict the reply answers.

key.description: The line that set the standing approval, by its id: what the standing approval's ceiling counts.

id.description: The approval written already approved, decided by the person who set the standing approval.

subject_hash.description: The digest of what was released; the subject itself stays on the approval.

standing.description: The line that set the standing approval, the same as the key.

verdict.description: The line that classified the reply this work answers.

category.description: The category of reply the standing approval covers.
